answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 56820 Country: Bangladesh Title: Unreadable Quran Question: What should be done to a Quran which is damaged by insects and is in no way readable? Answer ID: 56820 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 113/110/B=02/1436) They should be wrapped in neat and clean clothes and buried in any clean and respectable place in a pit. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
